app.name: MedNow
app.demoNotice: Demo data: practices, addresses, doctors and appointments are fictional.

emergency.disclaimer: MedNow does not replace medical advice. If life is at risk, call 112 immediately.

welcome.title: We’ll quickly find an appointment for you.
welcome.body: Free doctor appointments near you – shown honestly, booked in seconds.

location.title: Where are you looking?
location.body: With your location we show nearby practices and how far away they are. We only use it while you use the app and never store it.
location.postalCodeNotFound: We don’t know this postcode. Check it or use your location.
location.denied: No problem – just enter your postcode.

forWhom.title: Who are you looking for?
forWhom.ageHint: We only ask for the age group, never a date of birth.

interests.title: Which specialties do you need most?
interests.body: Optional – they’ll appear first on the home screen.

home.heroBody: We’ll show you right away where something is still free today.
home.heroNone: Fully booked today – we’ll show you the earliest appointments.
home.heroA11yHint: Shows nearby practices sorted by the earliest free appointment
home.todayEmpty: Nothing is free nearby today. This week looks better.
home.weekEmpty: Nothing is free nearby this week. Widen the radius or join a waitlist.

card.noSlotInWindow: No free appointment in this period

acute.title: Free today
acute.subtitle: Earliest appointment first, then the shortest distance.
acute.unknownHint: Best to give them a quick call.

search.title: Search
search.mapA11y: Map with {{count}} practices. The same practices are listed below.
search.clusterA11y: {{count}} practices in this area. Double tap to zoom in
search.mapUnavailable: The map isn’t available here. You’ll find all practices in the list.

practice.routeA11y: Open directions in your maps app

banner.unknown: No current appointment data – please call

practice.accessibilityNone: No accessibility information. Best to ask the practice.
practice.reviewsComingSoon: We’ll show individual reviews once there is a fair verification process.

booking.title: Book appointment
booking.holdNotice: We’re holding this appointment for you for {{minutes}} minutes.
booking.holdEndingA11y: One minute left before the appointment is released again.
booking.dependentNameHint: Only for you to tell them apart, e.g. “Mia”.
booking.reasonHint: Optional. Helps the practice plan. Please don’t share details about symptoms.
booking.contactHint: The practice needs this to reach you if anything changes.
booking.phoneInvalid: Please enter a valid phone number, e.g. 0661 123456.
booking.verifyBody: One time only: we’ll send you a 6-digit code so only you can manage your appointments.
booking.codeInvalid: That code isn’t right. Check it or request a new one.
booking.consentText: I consent to MedNow processing my appointment data and sending it to the chosen practice. This may reveal which specialty I am seeing (health data, Art. 9 GDPR). I can withdraw my consent at any time in the privacy centre.
booking.consentRequired: We can’t book the appointment without this consent.
booking.successBody: The practice has received your booking.
booking.remindersDenied: Notifications are off. You can allow them in your system settings.

errors.slotTaken: This appointment was just taken. Simply choose another time – the next free ones are right below.
errors.holdExpired: The reservation has expired. Just choose the appointment again.
errors.consentMissing: Please confirm your consent to book.
errors.verificationRequired: Please confirm your email address first.

appointments.title: My appointments
appointments.cancelConfirmBody: The appointment will be released so someone else can use it.
appointments.cancelled: Appointment cancelled. The slot is now free for others.
appointments.emptyUpcoming: No appointments yet. When you book one, you’ll find it here.
appointments.emptyPast: Your past appointments will appear here.

waitlist.title: Let me know
waitlist.body: When a matching appointment becomes free, you’ll get a message right away and have 10 minutes to take it.
waitlist.joined: You’re on the waitlist. We’ll let you know as soon as something opens up.
waitlist.left: You’re no longer on this waitlist.
waitlist.pushBody: To let you know right away, we need permission to send notifications. We only send messages about your waitlist.
waitlist.pushDenied: Without notifications we can only reach you in the app: open offers appear under “Appointments”.

offer.title: An appointment just opened up!
offer.expired: This reservation has expired. You’re still on the waitlist.
offer.declined: All right. We’ll pass it on and let you know about the next one.
offer.endingA11y: One minute left before the appointment goes to the next person.

notifications.offerBody: An appointment near you just opened up. Tap to confirm.
notifications.reminder24h: Your doctor’s appointment is tomorrow at {{time}}.
notifications.reminder2h: Your doctor’s appointment starts in 2 hours ({{time}}).

profile.title: Profile
profile.familyHint: Family members you book appointments for.
profile.reminders: Appointment reminders (24 h and 2 h before)
profile.anonymous: No account – your data stays on this device and in your anonymous session.

privacy.title: Privacy centre
privacy.intro: See what you have consented to and change it at any time.
privacy.revokeHealthBody: Without this consent you can’t book new appointments. Existing appointments remain.
privacy.crashReportsHint: Helps us fix bugs. No names, contact details, appointments or location. Servers in the EU (Frankfurt).
privacy.exportHint: A file with everything we have stored about you.
privacy.exportCopied: Your data was copied to the clipboard as JSON.
privacy.exportUnavailable: Export isn’t available in this browser. The app gives you a file.
privacy.deleteConfirmBody: Upcoming appointments will be cancelled, waitlists ended and all data deleted. This cannot be undone.
privacy.locationHint: Only while in use, rounded to about 100 m, never stored.

legal.placeholder: Placeholder – to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.
legal.imprintBody: Information pursuant to § 5 DDG will be added before launch: provider name and address, authorised representatives, contact, register entry, VAT ID.
legal.privacyBody: Before launch, the privacy policy will describe: controller, purposes and legal bases (incl. Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR), recipients (practices, processors in the EU), retention periods, data subject rights and the right to lodge a complaint.
legal.termsBody: Before launch, the terms of use will cover appointment brokering, cancellations and the exclusion of medical advice.
legal.accessibilityBody: MedNow aims to meet WCAG 2.1 level AA (German Accessibility Strengthening Act). Known limitations and a contact for reporting barriers will be added before launch.
legal.helpBody: MedNow shows free appointments at practices. For urgent complaints outside opening hours, the medical on-call service helps at 116117. If life is at risk, call 112.
legal.licensesIntro: MedNow uses open-source software and open data.
legal.osmAttribution: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License (ODbL).
legal.fontsAttribution: Fonts: Inter and Plus Jakarta Sans (SIL Open Font License 1.1).

errors.generic: That didn’t work. Please try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.

offline.banner: Offline – you’re seeing the last loaded results.

empty.radius: Nothing is free within {{radius}} km right now.
empty.noLocationBody: Enter your postcode or allow location access.

showcase.title: Components
showcase.toastSample: This is what a confirmation looks like.

diagnostics.title: Test build & diagnostics
diagnostics.intro: This page only exists in test builds. The details help with feedback and contain no personal data.
diagnostics.startupHint: Measured from the start of the app logic to the first usable screen. For a new measurement, close the app completely and open it again. The time before that (process start, splash screen) is measured by scripts/measure-startup.sh.
diagnostics.accessibilityHint: Helps with feedback on screen readers, text size and motion. Test plan: docs/accessibility-audit.md.
diagnostics.updateNone: The app is up to date.
diagnostics.updateReady: Update downloaded – the app will restart.
diagnostics.updateFailed: The update could not be downloaded. Please try again later.
